newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Pharmacia & Upjohn says to create new unit.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia & Upjohn says to create new unit.

text.p: Swedish/U.S. drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn said on Thursday it intended to combine its operations for parenteral nutrition and fluid therapy in a separate organisational unit in mid-1997.
The unit will have an annual sales of about $350 million, the company said in a statement.
The operations are currently under the Swedish unit Pharma Product Centre Sweden, the company said.
The change follows a decision to streamline operations for the company's prescription pharmaceutical business, which accounts for two thirds of the turnover, Pharmacia & Upjohn said.

"By concentrating operations within one organisational unit, we create better conditions for developing our strong position in the area of parenteral nutrition and fluid therapy," chief executive officer Jan Ekberg said.
